title: Final Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the distance d between the particles must be provided.

title: Center of Mass Acceleration
description: Essential Criteria: The acceleration of the center of mass must be correctly derived and stated.

title: Oscillation Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The frequency of small oscillations around the equilibrium position must be accurately calculated.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The general solution of the equations of motion for the particles must be correctly formulated.

title: Coulomb Force Inclusion
description: Important Criteria: The inclusion of the Coulomb force in the equations of motion must be correctly addressed.

title: Integration Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The constants of integration in the general solution should be mentioned, indicating awareness of initial conditions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit mistakes or inconsistencies in the final answers must be penalized.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or final expressions should be noted.
